title: Wireless vs wired DC fast charging efficiency test
summary: Bjorn Nyland compares wireless and wired DC fast charging for an electric car, measuring end-to-end efficiency. The test shows the wireless system holding up well against a plug.
why: HN cites it as the evidence that inductive EV charging can match wired charging in efficiency.

quote.text: You should check out this video where wireless charging beats wired charging in end to end efficiency
